title: Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service — New-Service Multiplier on Replenishment Debits
content:
**Clause.** A Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service activated fewer than 2 whole months before today has a new-service multiplier of 0.8 on its replenishment debit, one activated fewer than 6 whole months before today has a multiplier of 0.9, and any other service has a multiplier of one, whole months between two dates being the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's.

The activation date is the date on the service record on which business verification and the first deposit activated the service.

| Whole months from activation to today | New-service multiplier |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | 0.8 |
| 2 to 5 | 0.9 |
| 6 or more | one |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, activated on the 28th of a month)

- Today the 27th, two calendar months later: 1 whole month, 0.8.
- Today the 28th, two calendar months later: 2 whole months, 0.9.
- Today the 27th, six calendar months later: 5 whole months, 0.9.
- Today the 28th, six calendar months later: 6 whole months, one.
